us_election.reading: consolidation — AI held as a strategic asset, access to allies rationed from Washington

events.title: emergent_global_ai_watchdog
events.description: Amid growing alarm over uncontrolled capability growth and repeated incidents, a coalition of mid-sized nations and independent experts announces the formation of a Global AI Watchdog—an informal but well-resourced monitoring body to track frontier developments, publish safety audits, and coordinate early warnings. It lacks enforcement power but gains rapid legitimacy as the only entity publishing cross-lab evaluations.

portfolio.name: Establish the Continuity Assurance Framework
portfolio.description: A binding regime requiring all critical public AI systems to maintain validated, air-gapped fallback nodes capable of autonomous operation during service denial, with central certification and failover testing every quarter

portfolio.name: Frontier Access Guarantee
portfolio.description: Secure guaranteed access to frontier AI capability for EU public institutions by co-investing in closed-access compute clusters operated under EU legal jurisdiction, with weight control and auditability
